subject: Tenant environment validation & service mapping playbook
messages:
From: Natalie Porter <natalie@orchard-ai.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel.s@orchard-ai.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tenant environment validation & service mapping playbook

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for taking this on. We're starting Orchard AI's Private deployment intake and need a concise playbook you can run through with our infra team. High level asks:

- Confirm network prerequisites (VPC CIDR, required routes, NAT vs egress gateways).
- Service-port matrix (what outbound ports IPs to allow for pull images, telemetry, KMS).
- Ownership roster for day0 support (who's responsible for bastion, KMS, routing).
- Evidence we can hand back to our compliance team (sample smoke test checklist + telemetry pointers).

Attached is our initial service-port spreadsheet and a short intake doc — it's mostly blank. Can your team:
1) Populate a recommended port allowlist for a standard Redwood private deployment (including any ephemeral port ranges)
2) Flag anything we must fix before scheduling a staging cutover

Preferred timeline: we want a preflight review next week (week of 3/8). Miguel (cc) is our infra lead and will coordinate times.

Attachments: [attachment: orchard_service-port-matrix.xlsx]

Thanks,
Natalie Porter
VP, Platform Engineering
Orchard AI
From: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
To: Natalie Porter <natalie@orchard-ai.com>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel.s@orchard-ai.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant environment validation & service mapping playbook

Hi Natalie — great to meet you virtually. Happy to run the preflight.

Quick plan / next steps:
1) I'll fill the port/service matrix with Redwood's recommended allowlist and note which rules are strictly required vs optional for observability and batch pulls.
2) Internal owners: Ben Carter (Network lead) will validate routing/NAT patterns and ephemeral ranges, Kimberly Park (Security integrator) will confirm KMS/hardening questions, Karthik Iyer (Runtime) will verify KV cache and ingress expectations for the runtime. I will coordinate the playbook and run the call.
3) Deliverables before the call (target: 3/7 EOD):
   - Completed port-allowlist spreadsheet (orchard_service-port-matrix.xlsx)
   - One-page smoke test + evidence checklist (orchard_mav_v1.pdf)
   - Short slide (1-2) mapping Day0 ownership and escalation paths

Proposed times for the preflight sync (30–45m): Tue 3/9 10–11am PT or Wed 3/10 1–2pm PT. Tell Miguel to pick a time and I'll send a calendar invite with an agenda.

Sharing a working drive folder and a HubSpot record: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OrchardMAV (I've added the initial templates). HubSpot ticket HS-12987 will track delivery items.

I attached a draft mutual action plan (MAV) template as well — we can use it to capture ownership.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Tenant environment validation & service mapping playbook

Team — forwarding Orchard AI intake. Key asks below (see original message from Natalie). Can you each take the owner items listed?

Ben: can you:
- Review the VPC CIDR suggestions and confirm recommended NAT/EGRESS design.
- Populate the spreadsheet with source/destination rules we should ask Orchard to create (include expected IP ranges/ASN if image pulls are coming from cloud registries).

Kimberly: can you: 
- Validate KMS envelope flow and secret rotation notes on the MAV (particularly HSM/KMS integration and minimum roles).
- Call out any CIS-like hardening we require before activation.

Karthik: can you:
- Note runtime expectations (KV cache sharding, max token/window sizes, persistent storage needs, and any TTLs).
- Confirm whether we require any special host-level kernel flags or ulimits for inference runners.

I'll draft the smoke test checklist and owners doc and push updated files to the Drive by EOD 3/7. If anything here is a blocker for the 3/9/3/10 window, flag it now.

--
Chloe
From: Miguel Santos <miguel.s@orchard-ai.com>

Chloe — thanks, that plan looks good. We filled in the first pass of the service-port matrix and attached it here. We also added our expected CIDR ranges and a note about our egress gateway.

Attachments: [attachment: orchard_service-port-matrix.xlsx]

A couple of clarifications:
- We use a customer-managed KMS (Azure Key Vault). Will Redwood's on-prem package integrate with a remote KMS or do we need a local HSM? Please call out any latency or connection considerations you want us to test.
- For outbound image pulls, our registry is in us-west-2 and uses a set of ECR IP ranges; I've added the ranges to the matrix.

We'll take your timeline — Miguel is available 3/9 10am PT for the preflight. Natalie is looping in compliance for the evidence checklist.

Thanks,
Miguel Santos
Platform Engineer, Orchard AI
